one_line: Early 19th‑century British cavalry officer whose 1819 graffito in Ajanta’s Cave 10 marks colonial contact with the ancient site.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean and athletic cavalry build
appearance.face: Oval face with fair, lightly tanned complexion; straight nose, defined jaw, short sideburns, subtle stubble; sharp blue eyes with a focused, slightly conflicted default expression
appearance.hair: Short, straight light brown hair, neatly parted to the side, kept just above the collar; no facial hair beyond faint stubble; dark blue shako-style military cap with a black leather brim and a small brass badge worn in action scenes but absent in the default design
appearance.costume: Early 19th‑century British India cavalry uniform: fitted dark navy blue wool jacket with high standing collar and brass buttons, muted red collar facings and thin red piping along seams, cream cotton shirt barely visible at neck; beige riding breeches tucked into mid‑calf black leather riding boots; simple dark brown leather belt and shoulder strap, no ostentatious medals; sometimes a plain dark blue riding cloak for travel in the gorge but default is the jacket without cloak.
appearance.signature: A well-worn leather-bound field journal held in his left hand, with a simple graphite pencil tucked into the binding, symbolising his role in documenting Ajanta rather than a weapon.

ref_desc: Captain John Smith is a lean late‑twenties cavalryman with an oval fair face, short light brown hair, sharp blue eyes, a dark navy British India cavalry jacket with muted red trim, beige breeches, black riding boots, and a worn leather field journal.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character model sheet of Captain John Smith in a historically accurate early 19th‑century British India cavalry look: a lean late‑twenties man with an oval fair face, sharp blue eyes, short neatly parted light brown hair, and faint stubble, shown from multiple angles. He wears a fitted dark navy blue wool cavalry jacket with a high standing collar, brass buttons, muted red collar facings, and thin red piping along the seams, over a cream shirt just visible at the neck. His beige riding breeches are tucked into mid‑calf black leather riding boots, and a simple dark brown leather belt and shoulder strap cross his torso without ostentatious medals. In his left hand he always carries a well‑worn leather‑bound field journal with a pencil tucked into the binding, treated as his signature prop. Keep the palette dominated by dark navy blue, muted red accents, beige, black leather and light brown hair, and emphasise a dignified, reflective yet determined expression suitable for many panels in a historically grounded Indian history anime.
